messages.en: Thank you so much for wishing me a happy birthday~~
I read all the Rekords and Fromm messages. ㅠㅠ
You even congratulated me during my live.
Thank you.
Thanks to you, I think this is going to be the best birthday...
After all...

messages.ko: Y/n 랑 함께하는 생일이라 최고긴하지만 ㅎ
messages.en: It's the best because I'm spending it with Y/n. ㅎ
It's my first birthday with Hayeon.
Exactly. It's so touching.
It's my first time looking forward to the day after tomorrow this much.
Seriously, it's so touching.
My people.
Aww... ㅠㅠㅠ
Is there anything you want as a birthday present?
What if I said I want Y/n?

messages.ko: 나 지금 얼굴에 리본 묶는 중이야
messages.en: I'm tying a ribbon around myself right now.
Make sure you tie it nicely.
Are you coming to pick me up?
Of course. I'm coming to pick up my present.
Wait nicely for me~ ❤️
What do you want to do on your birthday?
Hmm~
I wonder?
Should we meet?
I want to see you.
Oh... it's already tomorrow now.

messages.ko: 나는 한국에 갈 수 없기 때문에 케이크를 사서 집에서 축하할 거야
messages.en: I can't go to Korea, so I'll buy a cake and celebrate at home.
Then let's eat it together over Bluetooth.
Among all the people wishing me a happy birthday,
I'm happy that Y/n is one of them.
Really.
What should we do on my birthday?
Eat cake.
And...
By any chance...
Are you going to make seaweed soup for me too~?
I'd be so touched~~~
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
Though... I'd probably make it better than you.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
